sections.title: Open work
sections.sql: select code,asset,title,status,due_date,assigned_to from backlog order by due_date

sections.title: Preventive work
sections.sql: select asset,name,next_due,next_meter,reading from pm_due order by next_due

sections.title: Parts to review
sections.sql: select code,name,quantity,reorder_level from stock_attention order by code

sections.title: Recorded downtime and labour
sections.sql: select code,name,site,corrective_jobs,downtime_minutes,labour_minutes,open_jobs from asset_reliability order by downtime_minutes desc

sections.title: Latest inspection per asset
sections.sql: select code,name,next_due,result,evidence_ref,competency_ref from inspection_status order by code
